procedure: Installed the project adaptive GTK2 palette into a private profile, opened a real GTK2 Button and Entry, changed synthetic KDE role export, refreshed generated GTK2 assets, and toggled Gtk.Settings gtk-theme-name from the KDE alias to its reload alias and back.
interpretation: The live GTK2 window updated its Window background and foreground text, but the pixmap-backed button face stayed at RGB (120,160,213) while the generated command-normal asset and KDE Button role changed. This is evidence of a partial refresh in this isolated setup, not proof of the real KDE/XSettings signal path; the alias toggle used Gtk.Settings directly.
limits: Synthetic role values were used only in a disposable profile.
The process used GTK2 Settings alias toggling, not a KDE XSettings notification.
No source files, personal profile, XChat, MAME guest, or VM state were changed.
next: Investigate why an open GTK2 process retains the old pixmap-backed button face after generated asset refresh, then validate the actual native reload notification before considering XChat application.
